purpose: Test variant_of when a qualifier makes explicit a property already constitutive of the broader corpus formulation rather than creating a distinct subtype.

relationAssessments.reviewNote: The general Nature evidence already presents nature as a plurality of living worlds that communicate and participate in divine life. Psalm 63 intensifies the same semantic core by calling nature living, the Father's wisdom, a book and a living organism. The qualifier 'vivante' therefore makes an existing property explicit rather than defining a cleanly separable subtype. variant_of is preferred to broader/narrower or equivalent_to.

explicitDistinctions.equivalent_to: Not established: the labels are not proven interchangeable in every corpus context.
explicitDistinctions.variant_of: Proposed from nature-vivante to nature because livingness is already constitutive of the general Nature evidence.
explicitDistinctions.broader_than: Rejected for this bounded dossier: the qualifier does not introduce a distinct application domain comparable to pensee-verticale.
explicitDistinctions.component_of: Rejected: Nature vivante is not assembled from Nature as one autonomous constituent among others.
explicitDistinctions.related_to: Too weak for the reviewed evidence because both formulations share the same semantic nucleus.

semanticBoundary.decisionRule: A qualified formulation can be a variant when the qualifier foregrounds a property already intrinsic to the base theme; it is broader/narrower only when the qualifier delimits a genuinely distinct subtype or application.

variationDimensions: nature as plurality of living worlds
